title: Restaurant service robot
summary: A JetBot that seated guests and delivered food to the right table using QR codes.
description:
For an Embedded Visual Control course project, I built a restaurant service robot for a model restaurant with four tables and a kitchen. The robot detected arriving guests, counted the group, selected a suitable table, and later collected food from the kitchen for delivery.

I implemented and integrated the camera, movement and decision-making components, including QR-code reading at the kitchen to direct the robot to the correct table, as well as obstacle detection and avoidance. I tested the system on the physical JetBot. In the final evaluation, it typically reached destinations in around 10 seconds, with positioning accuracy of about 5 cm.
